# Introduction to Digital Services

Elm Street Library offers four digital services. Almost every patron question at the desk is about one of them.

![The first-floor reading room, with the public computers along the window](https://images.example.org/elm-street/reading-room.jpg)

## Public computers

There are 12 computers on the first floor. Patrons sign in with their library card number and get **two hours** per day. Sessions can be extended if nobody is waiting.

### Printing from a public computer

Printing costs 10 cents per black-and-white page and 50 cents per colour page. Jobs wait in the print queue for 30 minutes before they're deleted.

#### Paying for printing

Patrons pay at the self-service kiosk next to the printer, with coins, a bank card or their library account balance.

#### Printing from a phone

Patrons can email a document to the printer's address, shown on the poster above it. The job appears in the queue under their email address.

## Wi-Fi

The network is called **ElmStreet-Public**. It doesn't need a password, but patrons must accept the terms on the welcome page. Staff use a separate network; see the [[Security]] guide.

## E-book and audiobook lending

Patrons can borrow up to **10 e-books** and **5 audiobooks** at once, for 21 days. Popular titles have a waiting list. The [loan diagram](../Technical/Diagrams.md#how-an-e-book-loan-works) shows each step.

## Online catalogue

The catalogue lists everything the library owns, including items at the two branch libraries. Patrons can place holds and renew loans online.

## Opening hours of the digital services desk

| Day | Hours | Staffed by |
|---|---|---|
| Monday to Thursday | 9:00 to 20:00 | Two staff members |
| Friday | 9:00 to 18:00 | One staff member |
| Saturday | 10:00 to 16:00 | Volunteers |
| Sunday | Closed | Nobody |
